newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Italian businessman killed in Bulgaria bar brawl.
newsitem.headline: Italian businessman killed in Bulgaria bar brawl.

text.p: An Italian businessman, Egidio Fruli, was found beaten to death in a luxurious night club in central Sofia, Bulgarian police said on Tuesday.

"The police found the body of Egidio Fruli, a 45-year-old Italian, in one of the corridors of the Three Musketeers night club. Fruli was beaten to death, there were no traces of gunshots," a police spokeswoman told Reuters.
The club owners called the police after 29-year-old Bulgarian Vasil Mitov was shot in a brawl between Bulgarian and Italian clients of the club, in which Fruli took part, police said.
State radio said that Mitov's companions had beaten Fruli to death after Fruli shot Mitov in the stomach. Mitov was later treated in hospital.

State radio quoted a visiting representative of the anti-mafia committee at the Italian Senate as saying that Fruli was a businessman who has attracted negative publicity for alleged involvement in Albanian pyramid investment schemes in which thousands lost their savings.
The police have launched an investigation.
Street killings and organised crime have become frequent in the past years as the Balkan state struggles with transition to free-market economy and democracy.
